import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
import time
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.feature_extraction import FeatureHasher
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

start_time = time.time()
print(f"Started at {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission template shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Text preprocessing - lowercase and basic cleanup
text_column = "comment_text"
label_columns = [
    "toxic",
    "severe_toxic",
    "obscene",
    "threat",
    "insult",
    "identity_hate",
]


def preprocess_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return text.lower().strip()
    return str(text)


train_df[text_column] = train_df[text_column].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df[text_column] = test_df[text_column].apply(preprocess_text)

# Word-level TF-IDF features (optimized for speed)
print("Vectorizing word-level features...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=8000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

X_word_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df[text_column])
X_word_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df[text_column])
print(f"Word features shape: {X_word_train.shape}")

# Character-level bigram features using hash for efficiency
print("Vectorizing character-level features...")
char_ngram_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(2, 2),
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

X_char_train = char_ngram_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df[text_column])
X_char_test = char_ngram_vectorizer.transform(test_df[text_column])
print(f"Character features shape: {X_char_train.shape}")

# Combine word and character features
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train = hstack([X_word_train, X_char_train])
X_test = hstack([X_word_test, X_char_test])
print(f"Combined features shape: {X_train.shape}")

# Labels
y_train = train_df[label_columns]
print(f"Labels shape: {y_train.shape}")

# Hold-out validation split - use 20% for validation
X_train_final, X_val, y_train_final, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.20, random_state=42
)
print(f"Train final: {X_train_final.shape}, Val: {X_val.shape}")

# Train models - optimized LightGBM parameters for speed
models = {}
for col in label_columns:
    models[col] = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=80,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        max_depth=4,
        min_child_samples=20,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        force_col_wise=True,
        reg_alpha=0.05,
        reg_lambda=0.05,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    print(f"Training model for {col}...")
    start_col_time = time.time()
    models[col].fit(X_train_final, y_train_final[col])
    col_time = time.time() - start_col_time
    print(f"Model for {col} trained in {col_time:.2f}s")

# Validation metrics
print("\nComputing validation ROC AUC...")
val_auc_scores = []
for col in label_columns:
    y_pred = models[col].predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    # Ensure y_val is not all same class
    if y_val[col].std() > 0 and y_pred.std() > 0:
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[col], y_pred)
    else:
        auc = 0.5
    val_auc_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"{col}: {auc:.6f}")

mean_val_auc = np.mean(val_auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Validation ROC AUC: {mean_val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_predictions = {}
for col in label_columns:
    test_predictions[col] = models[col].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission
print("Creating submission file...")
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "toxic": test_predictions["toxic"],
        "severe_toxic": test_predictions["severe_toxic"],
        "obscene": test_predictions["obscene"],
        "threat": test_predictions["threat"],
        "insult": test_predictions["insult"],
        "identity_hate": test_predictions["identity_hate"],
    }
)

# Save submission to the required path
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")

# Final timing
elapsed = time.time() - start_time
print(f"\nTotal time: {elapsed:.2f} seconds")
print(f"Collected at {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")
